question: Please find out how widespread the appeal of our top five actors is. What percentage of our customers have rented films featuring these actors?
sql:
-- Final answer: percentage of customers who have rented films featuring top 5 actors
WITH top_actors AS (
    SELECT a.actor_id
    FROM actor a
    JOIN film_actor fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id
    GROUP BY a.actor_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(fa.film_id) DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
films_by_top_actors AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT fa.film_id
    FROM film_actor fa
    WHERE fa.actor_id IN (SELECT actor_id FROM top_actors)
),
inventory_with_top_actor_films AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT i.inventory_id
    FROM inventory i
    WHERE i.film_id IN (SELECT film_id FROM films_by_top_actors)
),
customers_with_top_actor_rentals AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT r.customer_id
    FROM rental r
    WHERE r.inventory_id IN (SELECT inventory_id FROM inventory_with_top_actor_films)
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(1.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers_with_top_actor_rentals) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer) * 100, 2) AS percentage;
